core_meaning.primary_meaning: Safwa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Purity, the choicest part”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Safwa corresponds to the Arabic form صَفْوَة (Arabic root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w); صَفْوَة (Ṣafwa)). Its core sense is safwa; purity, the choicest part. Safwa is Arabic صَفْوَة (Ṣafwa) 'purity, the choicest part', from the root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w). The source gloss 'Pure, Hidden Treasure' is broadly consistent.

persian.name: صفوه
persian.long_meaning: Safwa (صفوه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن صفوه، برگزیده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
